C.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD/common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions to make denominators match.
Tag for mixed-number problems if only the fractional parts are equalized.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag mere rewriting of a whole number as x + 0/n unless it is part of denominator matching with an explicit common denominator step.
Do not tag simplification after subtraction.

skills.name: Normalize mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number or whole number into a subtraction-ready form, such as carrying from an improper fractional part or expressing a whole number as a mixed number with 0 fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a mixed number with 0 fractional part, such as 3 to 3 + 0/5.
Tag when this rewriting is done to align whole and fractional parts for later subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary combining of final whole and fraction parts.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping during subtraction; that belongs to a separate skill.
Do not tag equivalent-fraction conversion used only to match denominators.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and/or subtract the whole-number parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when a solution separates whole and fractional parts and performs those subtractions directly.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag finding the LCD or converting to equivalent fractions before subtraction.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping used because the fractional part would otherwise be negative.
Do not tag simplification of the result.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is too small.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to n/n in the fractional part.
Tag when a negative fractional difference is repaired by regrouping.
Tag for both mixed-number subtraction and whole-minus-fraction cases.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as x + 0/n before any regrouping.
Do not tag direct subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag simplification after regrouping and subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or convert a zero-fraction result to a whole number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0.
Tag when a mixed-number result uses the simplified fractional part.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction itself.
Do not tag combining an already simplified whole and fraction into final mixed-number form.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed-number input.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole and fractional parts and express the answer in an acceptable final form such as a mixed number, fraction, or integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly combines whole and fraction parts into one result.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted to present a proper fraction.
Tag when a whole plus zero fraction is written as an integer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the arithmetic subtraction steps that produced the parts.
Do not tag simplification of a fraction to lowest terms unless the step is specifically about reduction.
Do not tag initial rewriting of numbers before subtraction.

A.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when the denominators are not already aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators before subtracting.
Tag for mixed-number problems if only the fractional parts need denominator alignment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag steps that only subtract numerators after denominators are already aligned.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number unless a denominator conversion is also performed.

skills.name: Normalize whole or mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or a mixed number into a subtraction-ready form, such as adding a zero-fraction part or converting a mixed number with an improper fraction part to a standard mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to a standard mixed number.
Tag when the rewrite is done to make whole and fraction parts subtractable.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary combination of final whole and fraction parts into an answer.
Do not tag denominator conversion alone; that belongs to common-denominator work.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part; that is regrouping.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when a solution separates whole-part subtraction and fraction-part subtraction without regrouping yet.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping steps used to fix a negative fractional result.
Do not tag simplification of the result after subtraction.

skills.name: Regroup for subtraction
skills.definition: Borrow 1 from the whole-number part and convert it into fractional units when the fractional part of the minuend is too small to subtract the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when 1 whole is rewritten as n over n and added to the fractional part.
Tag when regrouping is used after an initial negative fractional difference appears.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag simple subtraction when no borrowing is needed.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator before subtraction; that is normalization.
Do not tag final combination of the answer after regrouping is complete.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or convert a zero-valued fraction to 0 or an integer when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor.
Tag when a result like 0/3 is rewritten as 0.
Tag when a whole-number result is recognized after the fractional part becomes zero.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that produce an already simplified result.
Do not tag combining a whole part and a nonzero fraction into a mixed number unless simplification also occurs.
Do not tag normalization or regrouping steps.

skills.name: Compose final answer
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole-number part and fractional part into the final mixed number, fraction, integer, or zero.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fraction results are recombined into one final value.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted to present a proper fraction.
Tag when a final integer or mixed number is explicitly stated from previously computed parts.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag intermediate subtraction of whole or fraction parts before recombination.
Do not tag simplification alone unless the step also explicitly forms the final answer.
Do not tag initial rewrites used to prepare the subtraction.

B.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize fraction units
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when the denominators are not already aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the same denominator.
Tag for mixed-number subtraction if only the fractional parts need denominator alignment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the fractions already have the same denominator and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag mere rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d unless it is part of denominator alignment with an existing denominator.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number such as 2 3/2 -> 3 1/2 unless a common denominator is also being found.

skills.name: Normalize mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number that has an improper fractional part into standard mixed-number form before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step changes a form like 2 3/2 into 3 1/2.
Tag when a mixed number with fractional part greater than or equal to 1 is converted to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag whether the normalized number is the minuend or subtrahend.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary conversion to a common denominator.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a mixed number with 0/d.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part during subtraction.

skills.name: Decompose mixed numbers
skills.definition: Represent whole numbers or mixed numbers as separate whole and fractional parts so corresponding parts can be subtracted.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as n + 0/d.
Tag when a solution explicitly separates a mixed number into whole-part subtraction and fraction-part subtraction.
Tag when the work sets up expressions like (whole difference) and (fraction difference) before combining.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag simple subtraction of two plain fractions with no whole-part structure.
Do not tag borrowing after a negative fractional difference appears.
Do not tag final recombination of the answer.

skills.name: Subtract aligned fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions once they share a denominator, including fraction parts inside mixed-number subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator.
Tag when fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted after denominators are already the same.
Tag when the subtraction yields zero or a negative fractional result before any borrowing adjustment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the step that creates equivalent fractions with a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping from the whole part.
Do not tag simplification of the resulting fraction.

skills.name: Borrow across whole-fraction
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as denominator/denominator and transfer it to the fractional part when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when 1 is rewritten as d/d and added to the fractional part.
Tag when borrowing is used in mixed-minus-mixed, whole-minus-fraction, or mixed-minus-fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when the fractional part is already nonnegative.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number before subtraction.
Do not tag final combination after borrowing has already been completed.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or convert a zero-fraction result to an integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced, such as 2/10 -> 1/5 or 9/12 -> 3/4.
Tag when 0/d is simplified to 0.
Tag when a combined result is expressed in simplest acceptable form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that already produce a fraction in lowest terms with no simplification shown.
Do not tag mere combination of whole and fraction parts if no reduction or zero simplification occurs.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number before subtraction.

skills.name: Combine final form
skills.definition: Assemble the computed whole and fractional parts into the final mixed number, fraction, or integer answer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step combines a whole-part result and a fraction-part result into one answer.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted to leave a proper fraction.
Tag when a zero fractional part is absorbed into an integer result.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag earlier decomposition into whole and fraction parts.
Do not tag simplification alone unless the step also explicitly combines parts into the final form.
Do not tag plain fraction subtraction items that end immediately with the subtraction result and no assembly step.
